audioplugin.description: AudioPlugin Reader: read selected text or agent-provided text aloud in VS Code. MiniMax is the default TTS provider.
audioplugin.commands.speakDocumentWithRo: Read Selected Text with Character Voices
audioplugin.commands.setApiKey.title: Set API Key
audioplugin.commands.pause.title: Pause / Resume
audioplugin.commands.stop.title: Stop
audioplugin.configuration.title: AudioPlugin Reader
audioplugin.configuration.properties.pro: [Common] TTS provider. Provider-specific settings live under audioplugin.<provider>.*.
audioplugin.configuration.properties.min: [MiniMax] Speech synthesis model. HD is higher quality, Turbo is faster.
[MiniMax][Multi-role] Default voice ID per role type. Keys: narrator/male/female/girl/boy/child/elderly.
[MiniMax] Language boost. Use auto for unknown languages.
[MiniMax] Pronunciation dictionary tone array, e.g. ["Omg/Oh my god"]. Omitted when empty.
[MiniMax] Sound effect name, e.g. spacious_echo. Omitted when empty.
[MiniMax] Extra MiniMax T2A request parameters (core fields are preserved).
audioplugin.configuration.properties.cac: [Common] Reuse cached audio for identical text and parameters.
audioplugin.configuration.properties.bro: [Common] External player browser path. Blank for auto-detect.
audioplugin.configuration.properties.rol: [Multi-role] Copilot model ID used for role analysis.
[Multi-role] OpenAI-compatible API endpoint for role analysis.
audioplugin.configuration.properties.sou: [Multi-role] Background sound effects library; subdirectories are scene categories.
audioplugin.languageModelTools.speakText: Use the configured TTS provider to convert text to speech and play it. Only use when the user explicitly requests speaking, reading aloud, playing, narrating, or text-to-speech. Consumes TTS quota and plays audio; do not use for general explanations or summaries.
Read text using the configured TTS provider.
The text to convert to speech and play.
Optional voice ID for the active provider.
Optional speech model for the active provider.
